name: VDL AI SEO
author: VaultDevLabs

sections.description:
VDL AI SEO helps you create and improve SEO-focused content without leaving WordPress.

Unlike generic AI writing tools, VDL AI SEO is built specifically for:

• Creating structured SEO outlines
• Analyzing existing drafts
• Refreshing and improving real posts
• Enhancing clarity, structure, and search intent

Everything happens inside the WordPress editor.

No dashboards. No switching tabs. No workflow disruption.

✨ What You Can Do

🔹 Generate SEO Outlines
Start from a topic and build a structured, search-ready draft framework.

🔹 Analyze Existing Content
Understand how your current draft performs before optimizing.

🔹 Optimize for Structure & Clarity
Improve headings, flow, structure, and readability while keeping your original intent.

🔹 Refresh & Re-Rank Existing Posts
Upgrade old content using AI suggestions tailored to your draft.

🔹 Preview Before You Insert
All changes appear in a preview panel. You stay in control.

💡 Built for Real WordPress Workflows

VDL AI SEO works inside:

• Gutenberg (Block Editor)
• Classic Editor

The interface separates:

• New Draft Creation
• Refresh & Re-Rank Optimization

So you always know what you’re doing and why.

🔓 Free + Optional Usage Limits

• Outline and Analyze are free
• Includes 3 free content optimizations per month
• Limits reset monthly
• Unused optimizations do not roll over

You can optionally configure an API key and/or license to enable usage tracking and plan limits.

🛡 Privacy

When you run AI actions (outline / analyze / optimize), relevant text and settings are sent to your configured external AI service to generate results and (if enabled) track usage.

No data is shared outside of those actions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in WordPress → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings → VDL AI SEO
  4. (Optional) Configure API / license settings
  5. Open a post or page and use the VDL AI SEO panel
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

No account is required to install the plugin.
To use AI features, you may need an API key and/or license depending on your configuration.

Does “Test Connection” use up usage?

No. Test Connection is free.

What counts as usage?

Running AI actions like Optimize, Analyze, or Outline may consume usage units depending on your configuration.
Includes 3 free content optimizations per month.

What data is sent to the API?

Only the text you submit (topic, draft content, page content) and the relevant generation settings required to produce results.

Where do I paste my license key?

Settings → VDL AI SEO.
